settings.about_mission_content: StarNyx helps you build steady habits through a quiet, focused experience. Progress should feel visible without becoming noisy.
settings.about_privacy_content: Your data stays on your device. StarNyx needs no account, does no tracking, and never sends your data anywhere.
settings.about_experience_content: A true-black interface made for OLED screens and late evenings. Calm colors, no clutter, and everything stays offline on your device, so each check-in remains a small act of quiet discipline.
